method: Each variant: 25 opening pairs, each replayed with sides exchanged. Conservation versus alternating Balanced/Pressing. Exactly equal compiled rosters. Independent seeds; 50 matches per variant, descriptive sensitivity check, not a ranking of compositions.
sourceCommitVerification: Every recorded source SHA-256 was verified against this commit after the run; measured source files were not changed. The after run initially used uncommitted files based on sourceBaseCommit.
